name: Dun Modr
summary: Dun Modr has fallen to Dark Iron dwarves, leaving the Thandol Span's southern approach in hostile hands. The fortress once changed hands in a fierce struggle during the Second War.

sections.title: A Contested Bastion
sections.body: At Wetlands' northern edge, Dun Modr commands the main road between Khaz Modan and the northern human kingdoms. That route has drawn armies to the fortress across the decades. During the Second War, the Orcish Horde seized the dwarven stronghold and used it to launch raids and resist Alliance armies. Stromgarde warriors sailed from Tol Barad to reclaim it, and the Orcs struck back in a bloody struggle. Alliance forces under Lord Anduin Lothar eventually drove the invaders south across the Thandol Span, returning the fortress to dwarven hands.

sections.title: The Dark Iron Incursion
sections.body: Dun Modr lay exposed while Ironforge's attention was divided and many of its finest mountaineers served the Alliance abroad. Dark Iron invaders took advantage, sabotaged the Thandol Span with explosives, then swarmed the fortress. Led by the warlock Balgaras the Foul, they overcame the defenders and drove out the Bronzebeard garrison. Mountaineers now hold a grim perimeter just down the road, seeking aid to drive out the occupiers.

faq.q: Why is Dun Modr so important?
faq.answer: Dun Modr commands the main northern road through the Wetlands to the Thandol Span. Whoever holds the fortress can control overland traffic, supplies, and military movement between Khaz Modan and northern Lordaeron.

faq.q: Who controls Dun Modr right now?
faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves hold Dun Modr, led there by the warlock Balgaras the Foul. Bronzebeard Mountaineers loyal to Ironforge watch from a nearby camp and hope to reclaim the fortress.

faq.q: What happened to Dun Modr during the Second War?
faq.answer: The Orcish Horde seized Dun Modr and used it as a forward base. Stromgarde forces attacked from Tol Barad, and fierce clashes followed until Anduin Lothar's Alliance forces drove the Horde from the region.
Balgaras the Foul is the Dark Iron warlock leading the occupation of Dun Modr. His forces damaged the Thandol Span and drove the local Ironforge defenders from the fortress.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing a storied Bronzebeard mountain settlement in Dark Iron hands is a bitter insult, and calls for vengeance.
As an Alliance member, you face a threat to the route across the Thandol Span, which links Ironforge with the northern Alliance remnants.
